mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_answers (id, question_id, content, user_id, like_count, comment_count, is_accepted, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{questionId}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{isAccepted}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.question_id, a.content, a.user_id, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.is_accepted, a.created_at, u.nick_name AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM forum_answers a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND a.status = 0 ORDER BY a.is_accepted DESC, a.created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM forum_answers WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM forum_answers WHERE id IN
#{id}
